examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.
И, Марина Сергеевна, читайте всё внимательно! Особенно мелким шрифтом!
examples.trans: And, Marina Sergeyevna, read everything carefully! Especially in fine print!
I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
All right, here you go. There, look.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: кишка тонка = not to have the guts

examples.text: Да у тебя кишка тонка ударить!
examples.trans: You do not have the guts to hit it!

examples.text: Ну, у кого там кишка тонка?
examples.trans: Well, who does not have the guts now?

examples.text: Раз ты такой крутой, познакомь нас!
examples.trans: Since you're so cool, introduce us!

examples.text: Ну раз ты такой крутой, может, познакомишь нас?
examples.trans: Well, since you're so cool, maybe you'll introduce us?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.en: darling; my baby (of a beloved car)

examples.trans: Don't you dare touch my baby!
Swallows are flying over the river.
Which car did you come in?

meanings.note: Как мужик = like a real man.

examples.trans: You should have acted like a real man!

examples.text: Что мы, мы? Тебе надо было как мужик!
examples.trans: What do you mean, we? You should have acted like a man!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

наделать.gloss: to do (something bad); to make a lot of

meanings.en: to do, to get up to (something bad)
meanings.note: что ты наделал? = what have you done?

examples.trans: Oh no, what have I done!
He made a lot of mistakes.

related.gloss: to get up to, to do (something bad)

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: Everyone saw you fly out the window.

examples.text: Над тобой вся страна смеётся! Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: The whole country is laughing at you! Everyone saw you fly out the window.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

examples.text: Потом надо отдать москвичам твои деньги из подвала.
examples.trans: Then I have to give your money from the basement to the Moscow people.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

разбить.gloss: to break, to smash, to wreck (a car)

examples.trans: Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Это от руля синяк! В какой машине? Ты машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: That's a bruise from a steering wheel! In what car? Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Я так вспоминаю. Значит, машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: I'm trying to recall it. So I wrecked the car, then?
Do you think that's really possible?
It's realistic to do that in a day.

examples.text: Я не шучу и реально сваливаю отсюда.
examples.trans: I am not joking and am seriously getting out of here.

meanings.note: ровно десять секунд = exactly ten seconds

examples.trans: Like a real man, exactly ten seconds.
They cut it exactly in half.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Как странно, я ничего об этом не слышал.
examples.trans: How strange, I've heard nothing about it.

meanings.note: Next door, or in the same flat.

examples.text: Соседи, привет! Слушай, дружок, дай свой телефон на минутку.
examples.trans: Hi, neighbours! Listen, buddy, lend me your phone for a minute.

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: Я считаю, что... = I think that.

examples.text: Эх, Паша, Паша. Ты считать не умеешь.
examples.trans: Oh, Pasha, Pasha. You can't count.
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Is the car in place? Did you check?

examples.text: Он припарковал старую тачку во дворе.
examples.trans: He parked the old car in the yard.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.trans: That was a very subtle move!

examples.text: У неё тонкий вкус в искусстве.
examples.trans: She has refined taste in art.

examples.text: Посмотрите, какое острое и тонкое лезвие!
examples.trans: Look how sharp and thin the blade is!
We give him three days. That's it.

тронуть.gloss: to touch, lay a finger on

meanings.en: to touch, lay a finger on (someone)

examples.trans: Just lay one finger on him!

examples.text: Только тронь его пальцем! Мы всегда рады видеть Даню здесь.
examples.trans: Just lay a finger on him! We're always glad to see Danya here.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Вот если бы он ребёнка ударил!
examples.trans: Now if he had hit a child!
He hit the table with his fist.

examples.text: Меня всё ребёнок не отпускает. Вот если бы он ребёнка ударил!
examples.trans: I can't stop thinking about a child. Now if he had hit a child!

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

examples.text: Хорошая, никто же не говорит. Эй, ты что?
examples.trans: She is good, nobody's saying she isn't. Hey, what's wrong?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
